## Review tier

- [ ] News (light: headline, why it matters, source)
- [ ] Frameworks and regulation (medium: checked against the primary source)
- [ ] Public attitudes (medium: figure, sample, fieldwork and wording checked against the release)
- [ ] Culture and industry (strict: editor plus a local reviewer)
- [ ] Sensitive topic (strict: editor plus a second reviewer)

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes, and every warning has been looked at
- [ ] Every new statement has a source, and every quote appears in its source
- [ ] Swap test: each new sentence would read as fair if it were written about a different country
- [ ] Disagreement inside the country is shown as disagreement
- [ ] "Recent development" items are within the window; older items are marked foundational
- [ ] Gaps are stated rather than filled
